title: The Orchard of Winter Fruit
rumor: The Orchard of Winter Fruit. Briarhearth families speak of an abandoned orchard where apples ripen beneath snow-covered branches. Its fruit is said to preserve remarkably well, and some elders believe the trees were planted by settlers who made a bargain with a woodland spirit. The orchard has been lost for years, although unusual fruit occasionally appears in the baskets of wandering traders.
first_lead: Sela Hallow has heard the orchard mentioned in older Briarhearth family histories.
